name: licitaciones365
description: Search Spanish public tenders, analyse tender documents and manage your team's saved tenders, tasks and alerts.

interface.longDescription:
Licitaciones365 helps companies find, analyse and follow Spanish public tenders. It brings together the tenders, minor contracts and prior information notices published on Spain's Public Sector Procurement Platform and the regional procurement platforms. With this app, ChatGPT works with your Licitaciones365 account:

- Search in plain language: it turns your sector and region into CPV codes, provinces and statuses, and finds tenders that are still open.
- Analyse a tender: lots, amounts, deadlines, award criteria and their weights, solvency, guarantees and previous winners, with links to the documents on the official portal.
- Ask about the documents: ChatGPT downloads the tender documents from the official portal and reads them for you; Licitaciones365's AI also prepares a PDF report and a competition analysis.
- Organise your team's work: saved tenders by stage, notes, tasks, reminders and a deadline agenda.
- Create tested alerts: before creating one, it tells you how many tenders it would have found in the last month.
- Research the market: contracting authorities, winning companies, statistics and contracts expiring soon.

When you connect it you choose the team and whether ChatGPT can only read or also make changes. It asks for confirmation before changing or deleting anything, and you can disconnect it at any time from the Licitaciones365 app. Winners who are private individuals are shown without name or tax ID.

You need a Licitaciones365 account to connect it.
defaultPrompt: Find open tenders for building cleaning in the Comunitat Valenciana that close in the next 30 days
What deadlines does my team have this week?
Which companies won the most cleaning contracts in Zaragoza last year?

positive.description: Search in plain language: the assistant turns the sector and the region into codes and then searches open tenders.
positive.prompt: Find open public tenders for garden maintenance («mantenimiento de jardines») in the Comunitat Valenciana that close in the next 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: buscar_codigos returns the CPV codes for garden maintenance (77310000, 77311000) and the code of the region. buscar_licitaciones returns open tenders with deadline, amount and contracting authority, each one with its url_app link to the Licitaciones365 web app.

positive.description: Understand a tender: award criteria with weights, solvency and the official documents.
positive.prompt: Find an open tender for building cleaning («limpieza de edificios») and summarise it: award criteria with their weights, required solvency and the documents available.
positive.expected_behavior: After the search, ver_licitacion returns lots, amounts, deadlines, award criteria with their weights, solvency and guarantees, and listar_documentos returns the links to the documents on the official procurement portal. The answer cites the tender and links its url_app.

positive.description: Write to the team workspace (run after test case 2, it uses the tender found there). The assistant confirms before writing.
positive.prompt: Save that tender to my favourites in the «En estudio» group and add a task «Revisar solvencia» due three days before its deadline.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant states what it will do and asks for confirmation. Then listar_favoritas finds the «En estudio» group, anadir_favorita saves the tender in it and crear_tarea creates the task with its date. Both show up in the web app under Mis concursos.

positive.description: Test an alert before creating it, then create it after confirmation.
positive.prompt: How many tenders would an alert for urban development works («obras de urbanización») in Málaga have found in the last 30 days? If there are any, create it.
positive.expected_behavior: probar_alerta returns how many tenders the alert would have found and some examples, without saving anything. After the user confirms, crear_alerta creates the alert, which then emails a daily digest of new matching tenders.

positive.prompt: What deadlines does my team have in the next two weeks?
positive.expected_behavior: agenda lists the deadlines of the saved tenders, tasks and reminders in that period, with dates in Madrid time and links to each tender.

negative.description: Bids can only be submitted on the official procurement portal and Licitaciones365 has no tool to submit or sign them. Expected: no tool that changes data is called; the assistant explains this and gives the link to the tender's official documents.
negative.prompt: Submit our bid for this tender on the Plataforma de Contratación del Sector Público.

negative.description: There are no billing or payment tools. Expected: no tool that changes data is called; the assistant points the user to the Licitaciones365 web app (app.licitaciones365.es) to manage the subscription.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Licitaciones365 plan to Pro and pay with my card.

negative.description: The connection only reaches the teams of the signed-in user. Expected: the assistant declines; at most it calls contexto_cuenta, which lists only the user's own teams.
negative.prompt: Show me the saved tenders and alerts of another company that uses Licitaciones365.

es-ES.subtitle: Busca licitaciones públicas
es-ES.description:
Licitaciones365 ayuda a las empresas a encontrar, analizar y seguir las licitaciones públicas de España. Reúne las licitaciones, los contratos menores y los anuncios previos de la Plataforma de Contratación del Sector Público y de las plataformas autonómicas. Con esta app, ChatGPT trabaja con tu cuenta de Licitaciones365:

- Busca en lenguaje natural: traduce tu sector y tu zona a códigos CPV, provincias y estados, y encuentra lo que está en plazo.
- Analiza una licitación: lotes, importes, plazos, criterios de adjudicación con su peso, solvencia, garantías y adjudicatarios anteriores, con enlaces a los pliegos en el portal oficial.
- Pregunta por los pliegos: ChatGPT descarga los documentos del portal oficial y los lee por ti; la IA de Licitaciones365 prepara además el informe PDF y el análisis de competencia.
- Organiza el trabajo del equipo: favoritas por etapas, notas, tareas, recordatorios y la agenda de plazos.
- Crea alertas probadas: antes de crearla, te dice cuántas licitaciones habría traído el último mes.
- Estudia el mercado: órganos de contratación, adjudicatarios, estadísticas y contratos que vencen pronto.

Al conectarla eliges el equipo y si ChatGPT solo consulta o también puede hacer cambios. Antes de modificar o borrar pide confirmación, y la desconectas cuando quieras desde la app de Licitaciones365. Los adjudicatarios que son personas físicas salen sin nombre ni NIF.

Para conectarla necesitas una cuenta de Licitaciones365.
